name_story.story: Samir can be understood through the Arabic form سَمِير, whose central sense is samir; evening companion. Samir is Arabic سَمِير (Samīr), denoting a companion in evening talk.

faq.a: Samir is associated with the Arabic form سَمِير, whose core sense is samir; evening companion.

faq.q: What is the origin of Samir?
faq.a: Samir is associated with Arabic. Samir is Arabic سَمِير (Samīr), denoting a companion in evening talk.
Yes — the underlying form سَمِير is Arabic.
Samir can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Samir should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Samīr is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Samir mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Samir is rendered سمیر and carries the sense سمیر، رات کا ساتھی.

faq.q: What does Samir mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Samir is rendered سمیر and carries the sense سمیر، هم‌صحبت شب.
A romanized syllable approximation is sa-mir. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Samir?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Samir, samir. Script forms are سمير, سمیر, سَمِير, समीर.

faq.q: Is Samir a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
